doc: Law states of the tier-1 physics layer (docs/design/TIER1_PHYSICS.md 10.2; read through house_sim/kernel/phys/lawbook.py). A law is the kernel applying a physical rule automatically during settle, a timed process or the environment system; the underlying functions are always callable whatever the state. A law that duplicates a domain's existing behaviour starts `deferred` so the verified specs see no change; it is flipped to `active` (stage D1, PHYS-FLIP) only after every domain in `duplicated_by` has routed its own code through the kernel and reported ready (adoption protocol, TIER1_PHYSICS 10.3). `order` is the position in the settle pass (TIER1_PHYSICS 6.1); null marks a law applied elsewhere (core place, a process, the environment system, or once after the ordered laws).

orphan.note: an item whose support vanished (destroyed, or its relation became invalid) falls

overflow.note: liquid above a container's capacity spills where the container stands

overload.note: shelves and surfaces over their rating collapse (admin storage._load_check)

hang.note: hooks, rails and rods over their rating pull out (manipulation hook ratings, mechanisms curtain rods)

crush.note: items under more load than they bear are crushed (manipulation max_load, stacking)

handle.note: carried bags, buckets and liners tear over their handle rating (manipulation bags, plumbing bucket handles, cleaning liners)

edge.note: an item whose centre of mass leaves its support falls (manipulation handling.after_placement)

slope.note: items slide, tip or roll on slopes and tilted supports (manipulation runaway and rolling watch, outdoor_plants slopes)

furniture_tip.note: unanchored furniture tips under front loads and pulls (mechanisms dresser, manipulation tip_check, safety tip_over, climate fan topple)

open_spill.note: open containers tilted, on their side or upside down lose liquid (manipulation orientation verbs, plumbing)

contact_heat.note: hot items scorch or melt the support they rest on (manipulation scorch, appliances surface_heat_limit_c)

wet_contact.note: wet or sweating items ring water-sensitive supports (manipulation ring stains)

thermal_shock.note: brittle items crack under a sudden temperature difference (appliances_cooking, cleaning's column)

phase.note: water-like liquids freeze and thaw; sealed rigid containers burst (plumbing ice; food liquids stay food-owned)

setdown.note: core place drops a held item from the speed's set-down height onto the support

drip.note: explicitly started drips deposit liquid down the support chain each substep (process)

creep.note: a support staged with phys_creep_s and still over its true rating collapses at that time (process)

carry.note: robot travel sloshes and topples what it carries (applied once after the ordered laws in the action phase)

melt.note: items above their melting point deform (admin MELT_MATERIALS, textiles iron; process)

thermal_tau.note: lumped m c / (h A) cooling time constants replace 300 sqrt(m) + 60 s (flips with plumbing_liquids and food after re-verifying cooling times)

wind.note: wind slides, tips and lifts loose outdoor items (environment system)

rain.note: rain wets exposed outdoor items and soaks paper (environment system)
